scheduledDistributionHint: When it is on, the platform queries SEFAZ on a schedule and pulls in the notes issued against the company tax id on its own. Manual retrieval on the notes screen keeps working.
scheduledDistributionReady: All set: the next cycle will fetch notes.
scheduledDistributionBlocked: Nothing will be fetched until this is resolved: {{reason}}
scheduledDistributionPaused: Routine paused: no automatic cycle scheduled.
scheduledDistributionLastRun: Last automatic run at {{moment}} — {{received}} note(s) received.
scheduledDistributionLastRunFailed: The last automatic run, at {{moment}}, failed. No note was received in that cycle.
scheduledDistributionError: Could not load the automatic retrieval state.
scheduledDistributionToggleError: Could not change automatic retrieval. Code: {{code}}.
scheduledDistributionReasonMissingSynthe: the automation operator has not been provisioned in this environment yet. Contact support.
scheduledDistributionReasonCertificateMi: there is no active digital certificate.
scheduledDistributionReasonCertificateNo: the digital certificate is not valid yet.
scheduledDistributionReasonCooldownActiv: SEFAZ is still within the mandatory interval between queries.
scheduledDistributionReasonUnknown: the API reported a block this screen cannot explain yet.
distributionCursorHint: The cursor tracks how far the platform has read SEFAZ's archive. It advances on every fetch and recovers on its own when SEFAZ refuses a query. Adjusting it by hand is only needed when SEFAZ loses the range where the platform stopped.
distributionCursorLastSkipped: Last skipped range on {{moment}}: from NSU {{fromNsu}} to {{toNsu}}.
distributionCursorNeverSkipped: No range has been skipped so far.
distributionCursorFieldHint: Fifteen digits, greater than the current position and at most {{nsu}}.
distributionCursorConfirm: Documents between the current position and NSU {{nsu}} will not be fetched, and the next query will only be allowed one hour from now. Confirm the adjustment?
distributionCursorAdjusted: Cursor adjusted. The next query happens after the one-hour window.
distributionCursorError: Could not adjust the cursor. Code: {{code}}.
distributionCursorLoadError: Could not load the distribution cursor.
